classification: Observed browser failure with exact current-source and server-log attribution
actor: Authenticated test user; server log records userId 62. The newly seeded Clinical Lead account remains unproved in the browser.
browser_observation: The in-app browser displays a 500 Server Error while the login surface remains visible. Retrying with the CLI-validated Clinical Lead credentials did not produce a usable signed-in page.
server_log_observation: storage/logs/laravel.log records Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\RelationNotFoundException: Call to undefined relationship [user] on model [App\Models\Shift]. The failure occurs while HandleInertiaRequests evaluates the global task navigation badge.
root_cause: ShiftTaskProvider eager-loads and reads shift.user, but Shift defines the rostered-user relationship as staff().
scope: The navigation task count is shared through authenticated Inertia responses, so one relationship-name mismatch can fail otherwise unrelated signed-in pages.
mutations: No domain form, workflow, or download was executed. A local synthetic Clinical Lead user/profile/site fixture was created with explicit user permission; it does not prove the supported staff-creation workflow.
claim_limit: The exact 500 and current-source mismatch are proved. Clinical Lead screen access and the full set of affected routes are not claimed because the signed-in shell could not render.
